protocol_name: USDJPY accuracy V2 audited realtime-aligned anti-overfit protocol
change_reason: Before any V2 live forecast, correct candidate-specific training samples, use Newey-West lag 1 for partially overlapping forecast windows, and freeze the historical foundation; earlier registration-only ledgers are retained.

candidate_definitions.fair_value_convergence: origin_spot * exp(lambda * log(rolling_fair_value / origin_spot)); lambda selected from a fixed grid using available past targets only
candidate_definitions.change_ridge: target log return on rolling log fair-value gap, delta Tankan and delta 10-year spread
candidate_definitions.policy_3m_ridge: target log return on rolling log fair-value gap, delta Tankan and delta US-Japan 3-month interbank spread from ALFRED vintages
candidate_definitions.two_year_spread_ridge_semi_strict: diagnostic target log return on rolling log fair-value gap, delta Tankan and delta US-Japan 2-year government yield spread; Japan history is current-file data and cannot support a historical realtime claim
candidate_definitions.dynamic_two_factor: discount-factor Kalman model of target level using origin 10-year spread and Tankan; one shared discount parameter
candidate_definitions.rw_floor_ensemble: nonnegative ensemble of the five valid models, shrunk toward fixed prior weights and retaining at least 35% random walk

information_rules.market_cutoff: calendar day before Tankan release for ALFRED date-granular vintages
information_rules.policy_3m_alignment: latest common observation date present in both US and Japan ALFRED snapshots by the market cutoff
information_rules.inner_validation_purge: for every pseudo-origin, train only on rows whose target_available_date is on or before that pseudo-origin release date
information_rules.historical_outcome_grade: frozen final quarter-end DEXJPUS observations, availability-gated but not point-in-time outcome vintages; archived vintage comparison found no differing values in the covered sample

anti_overfit_rules: The log-return target and log fair-value gap were fixed before viewing this protocol version's strict OOS results.
No hyperparameter or feature grid may be expanded after reading V2 OOS results under this protocol version.
Every hyperparameter choice is made with outcomes available before that forecast origin only.
Inner time-series validation applies the same target-availability rule at every pseudo-origin; positional adjacency is never treated as availability.
Each candidate uses only the past rows required by its declared feature set; unrelated feature availability cannot narrow its training sample.
The diagnostic two-year model is excluded from the ensemble and all historical promotion claims.
The final shadow model is the predeclared RW-floor ensemble, not the ex-post lowest-RMSE component.
Any protocol change creates a new version and a new forward ledger.
